text:
Marie: heads up — ran a scan for API keys that are still active but whose project was deleted. billing shows org quotas still being consumed. thinking we need a documented "handback" grace period plus a console flag to claim orphaned keys. thoughts?

Alex: ugh. do we know how many keys? could be a cheap UI signal + telemetry initially. also want to track last_used_ts so we don't reclaim recently used keys. :thinking:

Tariq: found ~220 keys across ~40 orgs in last week. quick query I ran:```sql
SELECT key_id, org_id, project_id, last_used_ts 
FROM api_keys
WHERE project_deleted = true AND revoked = false;
```
most haven't been used in >90d.

Sam: is this a billing problem or a security problem? If the project is gone, who 'owns' the key? we need a policy before we show UI.

Marie: both. billing leak + risk of forgotten keys still live. proposal: 30-day grace from project deletion where console shows "orphaned — claimable by org admins", after 30 days automatically attribute quota usage to org billing and mark as restricted until claimed.

Nate: auto-attribution worries me for customers who delete projects for GDPR reasons. we should add an opt-in org-level retention policy and a clear audit trail. also add a customer-facing email notifying owners before move.

Lena: UX note: "claim" language sounds like ownership transfer. maybe "reassign to org" or "shelve for org admin". we should show the original project name + deletion timestamp and last activity. small CTA: "Request transfer / Delete key".

ops-bot: [alert] orphan-key-detector found 18 new orphaned keys since midnight for org:acme-corp (auto-scan). :rotating_light:

Alex: telemetry item: tag traces with "orphaned_key=true" when requests match keys with project_deleted=true. that'll help understand production impact before policy change.

Tariq: implementation notes: backend change will need a new `key_state` enum: ACTIVE, ORPHANED, SHELVED. routing/quotas need to check `key_state` for attribution. patch I sketched:```diff
+ALTER TYPE key_state ADD VALUE 'ORPHANED';
+UPDATE api_keys SET key_state='ORPHANED' WHERE project_deleted=true AND revoked=false;
```
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/xxxx

Sam: how do we handle impersonation chains / delegated service accounts? if a service account token uses an orphaned key upstream, attribution is messy. need rules that stop double-charging.

Marie: good call — we should compute attribution by first non-orphan principal in chain, fallback to org. add a telemetry tag `attribution_source` with values project|org|delegated.

Lena: small copy test for console: "This key belonged to Project X which was deleted on 2026-02-10. An org administrator can transfer this key to another project or schedule permanent deletion. Unclaimed keys will be shelved for 30 days."

Nate: ok from security perspective if we add audit log, notification, and allow immediate deletion. agree to trial 30-day grace default with org opt-out.

Marie: next steps: (1) add telemetry tag + query to op-dashboard, (2) backend enum + transition, (3) console flag + copy per Lena, (4) email notification template + audit log. I'll open a consolidated RFC and link the PRs. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: created ticket INF-7213 for orphaned key handback work.

Alex: ping @security and @billing to review RFC when it's up.

Marie: will do. thanks all — moving to RFC stage.
